$comment: Capability records for the Israeli B2B wholesale pilot. Each states what Odoo can do for a business, keyed to the requirement topics normalisation produces, and each carries the source evidence that supports it. Status is draft until an AIOne functional reviewer verifies it; a draft capability may inform a blueprint but cannot approve one (Blueprint §8).

description.he_IL: ניהול מלאי בכמה מחסנים, עם זמינות ותנועות לכל מחסן בנפרד.
description.en_US: Manage stock across several warehouses, with availability and moves per warehouse.

evidence: stock declares 17 security groups including group_adv_location (Manage Push and Pull inventory flows)
stock defines 51 models and ships 77 access rules
limitations: Routes between warehouses beyond the standard receipt and delivery flows need configuration review.

description.he_IL: מעקב אחר פריטים לפי מספר סידורי מקבלה ועד אספקה, כולל הצגת המספר במסמכי משלוח.
description.en_US: Track items by serial number from receipt through delivery, including showing the number on delivery documents.

evidence: stock declares group_lot_on_delivery_slip (Display Serial & Lot Number in Delivery Slips)
limitations: Per-product configuration decides whether tracking is by serial, by lot, or none.

description.he_IL: מעקב אחר פריטים לפי אצווה, מקבלה ועד אספקה.
description.en_US: Track items by lot from receipt through delivery.

evidence: stock declares lot and serial groups in security/stock_security.xml

description.he_IL: ניהול תאריכי תפוגה לאצוות ומניעת אספקה של פריטים שפג תוקפם.
description.en_US: Manage expiry dates on lots and prevent delivery of expired items.

evidence: stock exposes module_product_expiry as a configuration switch, which installs a further module
limitations: Blocking delivery of expired stock depends on the removal strategy and alert configuration; whether it is a hard block or a warning needs functional confirmation.
capabilities.residualGap: Whether expired stock is blocked or merely flagged is unconfirmed at this revision.

description.he_IL: ניהול כמה חברות משפטיות במסד נתונים אחד, עם הפרדת רשומות ודיווח לכל חברה.
description.en_US: Run several legal companies in one database, with record separation and per-company reporting.

activation.evidence: base declares base.group_multi_company; company records are created as configuration

evidence: base declares 13 security groups including group_multi_company
stock and account both reference base.group_multi_company in their data
limitations: Intercompany flows and consolidated reporting are separate capabilities and are not covered by this record.

description.he_IL: מתן הנחה ברמת שורת הזמנה, מוגבל למשתמשים בעלי ההרשאה המתאימה.
description.en_US: Apply a discount at order-line level, restricted to users holding the discount permission.

evidence: sale declares group_discount_per_so_line (Discount on lines) in security/res_groups.xml
limitations: This controls who may enter a discount. It does not require anyone to approve one.

description.he_IL: נעילת הזמנות מאושרות כך שלא ניתן לשנותן ללא הרשאה.
description.en_US: Lock confirmed sales orders so they cannot be edited without permission.

description.he_IL: לוח חשבונות ישראלי ודוחות מקומיים, כבסיס להנהלת חשבונות בישויות ישראליות.
description.en_US: Israeli chart of accounts and local reports, as the basis for accounting in Israeli entities.

activation.evidence: l10n_il extends account.chart.template; the template is applied at company setup

evidence: l10n_il defines no models and extends only account.chart.template
l10n_il_reports is the only other l10n_il module at this revision
account declares 11 security groups and 125 access rules
limitations: The localization supplies a chart and reports. Invoice numbering rules, tax-authority submission formats and document layouts beyond these two modules are not covered.
Financial policy is unverified until an authorized finance owner confirms it.
capabilities.residualGap: Israeli reporting obligations beyond the chart and standard reports are unestablished and need finance review.

description.he_IL: דרישת אישור להזמנות רכש מעל סכום מוגדר.
description.en_US: Require approval for purchase orders above a defined amount.

evidence: purchase declares group_purchase_manager and group_purchase_user in security/purchase_security.xml
purchase exposes double-validation configuration on res.config.settings
limitations: The threshold is a single amount per company. Multi-step or role-specific approval chains are not covered.

unresolvedTopics.reason: No capability in the pilot module set requires an approval before a discounted quotation is confirmed. sale controls who may enter a discount, not who must approve one.

candidatesRequiringVerification.question: Can the Enterprise approvals framework gate confirmation of a sales order carrying a discount above a threshold, without custom development?

unresolvedTopics.treatment: Fit assessment stays unresolved until an Odoo functional reviewer answers the question above. The alternatives are a verified Enterprise capability, Studio or an automation rule, or a custom-development gap.

unresolvedTopics.reason: Customer credit limits exist in account, but whether an approval is required before exceeding one is not established at this revision.

candidatesRequiringVerification.question: Does the credit-limit feature block or merely warn, and can blocking be gated by an approval?
